---
title: "About"
---

```{=html}
<div class="panel-card">
  <h3>Project purpose</h3>
  <p>This website demonstrates how a clean data story can be built around election results. The design emphasizes clarity, readability, and a polished presentation so that maps and summaries feel easy to interpret.</p>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="feature-grid">
  <div class="feature-card">
    <h3>Data source</h3>
    <p>Official North Carolina State Board of Elections results files are used for the county-level map in the analysis section.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="feature-card">
    <h3>Design goals</h3>
    <p>The site uses layered panels, stronger color contrast, and a contrast-friendly layout to improve the visual depth of the experience.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="feature-card">
    <h3>Tools</h3>
    <p>Quarto, R, and tidyverse are used to transform raw election data into a readable site with polished visuals.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
